about:
Pit stops that we are constructing all over Azerbaijan offer a place to rest during a trip. The ongoing project is called “Dayan-Dincəl.”
Having started in 2018 the project aims to boost mobility among Azerbaijani cities and facilitate tourism development.
We collaborated with the local government and analyzed carefully all the roads, locations as well as touristic destinations for the smart placement of “Dayan-Dincəl” pit stops. This allowed us to map all the pit stops at the most convenient locations both for the local travelers and foreign visitors. Each pitstop is arranged within an interval of 25 kilometers.
